fusions.name: Tethered Weight
fusions.desc: Flings a weight on a chain for 7 damage; it then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of that. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Lashing Arc
fusions.desc: Swings a length of chain through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage with a 60% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Hauled In
fusions.desc: Hauls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tightening Links
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 12. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (326% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
